Container.Name: SyncHub
Container.Overview: SyncHub keeps Letterboxd/Serializd watchlists, Jellyfin, Radarr and Sonarr in one place, shows what you have, what is on its way and what is missing, and adds wanted titles to Radarr/Sonarr. It also has a whole-house TV remote (Roku, Google TV / Android TV) that plays Jellyfin titles. For the TV remote's automatic discovery and Wake-on-LAN, give the container its own address on your network (Network Type: Custom br0) or use Host; everything else works on the default bridge.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port SyncHub's pages are on. With a custom br0 address the container has its own IP and this is ignored.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, logs, poster cache, TV settings and backups. Use the cache or pool path, not /mnt/user (SQLite needs real file locking).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 is Unraid's nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 is Unraid's users).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For the logs and the nightly backup at 03:30, for example America/Los_Angeles.
